title: Passing Yards V238 Runtime Cache Bust
root_cause: GitHub/local branch proof executes the new V237 direct-shell code, but hosted Streamlit continues to commit NFL and Passing Yards while never exposing V85. app.py continued importing the same V237 module identity, allowing a hot-rerun process to satisfy the import from an already-loaded module.
patch: Create brand-new V238 entrypoint. Passing Yards detection, V85 ownership, hidden activation marker, and V187 direct-shell dispatch live in V238. app.py changes one import from V237 to V238. Non-Passing routes delegate to V237 unchanged. No dependency rebuild is used.
acceptance: app.py imports V238 and no longer imports V237 directly.
Passing Yards uses V238 marker + V85 owner + V187 direct shell without delegating to V237.
Non-Passing routes delegate to V237 exactly once.
V237, V236, V187, V85, requirements and Monster sitewide owners remain byte-identical.
Branch real UI exact NFL -> Passing Yards selection exposes V238 and V85.
DevSystem final gate passes before merge.
